title: corpus_profile.json
description: Runtime adaptation layer: a cache of facts the tools self-discover about THIS messy drive at run time. Written under a gitignored artifacts dir and gitignored by name — it holds raw secrets (decrypted passwords / alias answers) and MUST NOT be committed. This schema is the secret-free contract; only a live run populates values. See src/rag/tools/profile.py.

passwords.description: corpus-relative file path -> the password that decrypted it (self-discovered at run time; NEVER hard-coded in source).

aliases.description: canonical company name -> list of aliases/case-codes observed to refer to it.

formats.description: free-form key -> discovered format fact (e.g. real xlsx data-sheet name, resolved highlight colour).
